messages:
Marta: quick RFC follow-up: we should add a resilience hint in the probe so control plane can decide when to prefer manifest-backed fallbacks vs retrying the adapter.
Ethan: good call. observed some adapters return transient 503s under load; runtime currently retries blindly and doubles latency. resilience hint could guide backoff shaping.
Lina: proposal: probe includes `resilience_profile` with keys: `max_concurrent`, `preferred_backoff_ms`, `retryable_transients`. keep it small.
Corey: ops/security: ensure the profile contains no tenant identifiers and is purely capability/behavioral. default `no_secret_proxy=true` as usual.
Marta: example probe snippet we discussed:
```json
{
  "probe_version":"1.1",
  "capabilities":["streaming","batch_infer"],
  "resilience_profile":{
    "max_concurrent":64,
    "preferred_backoff_ms":150,
    "retryable_transients":["503","504"]
  },
  "feature_versions":{"batch_infer":"v1"}
}
```
Ethan: runtime behavior idea: if request would exceed `max_concurrent`, either queue briefly or route to manifest path depending on `residency_hint` and tenant tier. we should add `residency_strength` interplay rules to RFC.
Lina: tradeoffs: pro 1 smaller probes let runtime make smarter decisions; con 1 adds decision logic server-side and more knobs to test. note it for the doc.
Corey: testing: unit schema checks, integration test that simulates adapter returning `max_concurrent`=1 and verifies runtime backoff/route switch, and a canary where 0.2% traffic uses the fallback path.
sre-bot: created RFC update draft: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/adapter-probe-resilience (comments open) :white_check_mark:
Marta: rollout plan: publish probe schema -> adapters implement resilience_profile (best-effort) -> control plane honors hints for non-enterprise tiers -> after 2 weeks canary expand to paid/enterprise with secret-proxy gating.
Ethan: metrics: `adapter_probe_mode`, `resilience_route` (probe_direct|manifest_fallback|queued), and `adapter_retry_rate`. alert if queued >1% for 12h.
Lina: security note: `retryable_transients` must not be used to infer or surface any request contents. its purely status-code surface. add a sentence in the RFC.
Corey: implementation nit: include `compat_hash` and `compatibility_ttl` so runtime caches decisions. also X-headers: `X-RW-Probe-Ver` and `X-RW-Compat` to avoid extra RTT.
Marta: I'll fold this into the RFC with the resilience hints, test checklist, and canary thresholds. pinging eng-runtime, eng-platform, and eng-sre for review. small sync tomorrow 9am PT? :calendar: 
Ethan: 9am PT works.
Lina: added to my calendar.
Corey: prepping SRE playbook draft.
